summary: Iteration 4 covered the 4 new items: (1) NEW backend GET /api/featured-cars — 2 pytest tests PASS: returns {success:true, cars:[...]} with 12 featured cars whose ids overlap the documented homepage set (273/292/268/281/290/262/191/185/280/282/181/180) and each car exposes id/name/brand/category/price. (2) NEW backend POST /api/contact — 2 pytest tests PASS: returns {success:true, message:'Message received'} and 422 for missing 'message' field; record persisted in db.contacts (id, name, email, message, created_at). (3) NEW Contact screen /contact — tapping settings-contact-form on Réglages navigates to /contact; empty submit shows contact-error 'Veuillez remplir tous les champs'; filled submit shows success screen 'Message envoyé !' with contact-back-home button. (4) Home hero renders the react-native-svg AIRBCARS logo in WHITE without any red screen or component error and shows 12 featured car cards from /api/featured-cars; tapping still routes to /car/{id}. Theme: blue primary #2563EB visible on hero button, Réservations tab, active Réglages checkmark, category icons, and 'Retour à l'accueil'. Full pytest suite: 18/18 PASS (added TestFeaturedCars + TestContact classes; all prior regression classes for cars/pagination/car-price/bookings/franchise still green). Non-blocking: same RN-Web '"shadow*" style props deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' console warnings as prior iterations — cosmetic only.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings persist: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking RN-Web migration warnings — do not affect native builds. Reference: multiple StyleSheet.create blocks.

action_items: (Optional polish) Migrate remaining shadow*/pointerEvents style props to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.get_featured_cars caches scraped homepage ids for 10 min in _featured_cache — good, keeps latency low; fallback to first 8 catalog cars if scraping yields nothing prevents empty Home.
FEATURED_ID_RE matches 'booking.php?id=NNN' anywhere in HTML — safe because homepage only lists booking links for featured cars; ordering preserved via list-with-dedupe.

POST /api/contact stores {id, name, email, message, created_at} in db.contacts with a UUID id (no Mongo _id leaked in response). Pydantic ContactCreate enforces non-optional name/email/message → 422 on missing fields (verified).

Logo.tsx uses react-native-svg primitives (Svg/Polyline/Line/Path/G) with a single color prop driving both stroke and fill — renders correctly white on dark hero and blue (#2563EB) on Settings without crash.

theme.ts brand switched to #2563EB and brandSecondary #1D4ED8; consistent usage across buttons, active tab, chips, category icons. surfaceInverse (#1E3A8A) is intentionally a darker navy for inverse surfaces — consistent.
